region_rules.staff_head: Square side 0.22*H centered at video_cut.track tip_xy, center shifted up by 0.06*H. Null-tip fallback: topmost alpha>=128 point outside head box; no fallback needed in this sequence.
region_rules.pauldron: Far shoulder in right profile: x=[torso_cx-0.16*H, torso_cx+0.12*H), y=[head_top_y+0.10*H, head_top_y+0.32*H). torso_cx is mean x of base alpha>=128 pixels whose integer y lies in [head_top_y+0.20*H,head_top_y+0.45*H).
region_rules.rounding: Floor lower box coordinates, ceil upper box coordinates, clamp to [0,512]; exclusive upper bounds.
region_rules.tracking: Single ordered call on all 12 base alpha channels; frozen default working_scale=0.5 and three-frame median head_top_y retained.
region_rules.outside_regions_drift: sum(max(base_alpha,variant_alpha)/255 * mean_channels(abs(base_RGB-variant_RGB)) * outside_both_boxes) / sum(max(base_alpha,variant_alpha)/255 * outside_both_boxes); straight RGB, 0..255 units. Alpha union is per-pixel maximum.

gear_layer_strip.definition: Exact variant RGBA bytes inside the union replacement mask, transparent elsewhere, alpha-composited onto background. Fully transparent replacement bytes erase base pixels but are invisible on this strip.

concerns: Visual inspection of frames 00, 03, 06, and 09 shows frozen video_cut.track tip_xy on the hair rather than the staff tip. The required non-null coordinates were retained; the declared staff-head boxes miss the added staff ornaments, which are consequently excluded from the composite.

Outside-regions drift compares original source frames with reconstructed edited frames; it includes sheet resampling/matting differences as well as generator changes. No round-trip baseline subtraction was requested or performed.
